batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b AB Dinda

balls.text: this he gives himself room and drives it through the covers. One is easily had and Kartik is content with it, Rahul Sharma wants a second - and why not - but he is sent back. Dinesh Karthik gets the throw and is far away from the stumps, but he does well to throw down the wickets from about a yard or so away.
another one in the block-hole and Kartik can only manage to hit it back to the bowler.
quicker one from Munaf this time and into the block-hole. Beats Kartik all ends.
Slower one again and Smith waited for its arrival before smacking it away. But it also went straight to Pollard at the deep mid-wicket region, who pulls it off rather easily!
slower one and Smith swings hard but does not get anywhere on the bat. Beaten!
Smith went very early to the off side and gave away his intentions of playing it over the short fine-leg. Munaf bowled it slower but Smith still managed to get it over the fielder.
drilled away again and that could so easily have gone to the fence as well, but it went straight to Harbhajan in the covers. Only a single allows Smith to retain strike.
short one and Smith's absolutely hammered it into the gap between square-leg and long-on
this time the batsman makes room for himself and Malinga pushes it outside the off-stump. Smith wanted a wide, the umpire did not oblige!
another yorker length ball and Kartik jabs the bat at it and runs away for a single. His lack of bat-lift is helping him.
change of pace and Smith swings it hard! But it goes to the fine-leg for only a run.
another one pitched right up to the batsman and Kartik does well to not only dig it out but also get a single.
allows the ball to turn into the bat and then gently dabs it away to the off side for a single.
What is happening?! Kartik has suddenly come in and hit a four and now this six over the long-on fence to make life that wee bit simpler for the Warriors.
Ho ho! Kartik was going down the track this time but hits him on the pad only...
swept away and that will go all the way to the fence! Being a left-handed batsman obviously helps!
what a ball! This one has pitched on the leg-stump and the new-comer had no clue after it turned and bounced on him. Beaten, bowled and bye-bye!
and turn again, pitched outside the leg stump and makes it difficult for the batsman.
down the leg-side and that is played away neatly for a single to fine-leg.
slower one and short of length and Smith tries to pull. Mistimes it but the ball runs away to long-on for a run.
good shot from Smith, very high back-lift and still drills it to mid-off, who was inside the circle.
another one pitched up but not as full as the previous one and its driven to long-on for a run.

block-hole and bowled! Malinga, barring that CB series to an extent, bowls these at will, and he has done it again. Samuels tried to give himself some room but failed to get his bat down in time and the ball has done its damage to the stumps.
shorter length ball from Malinga and that is nudged away to the backward short-leg. A couple of runs for Samuels.
that is a short one from Pollard, much like he has been doing all this while. This time, however,  Smith gives it all and yes, most vitally, gets it to the right of deep square-leg for a four.
flick it away to the leg-side for a couple of runs.
a bit short from Pollard and Samuels tries to smash him away. Only gets a single to long-on.
flicks him from outside the off-stump and gets a single to the leg-side.
pitched right up to Samuels and he tries to go over the top almost immediately. Does not get too much elevation and goes on one-bounce to mid-off.

slower one and that has got the break through that the side needed! Uthappa tried to swing it away to the leg-side but got only a leading edge and that went high in the air before the bowler came under it and gobbled it up with ease.
change of pace, beats the batsman but the edge off Smith's bat also beats the short third-man fielder! better over for the Mumbai Indians!

pitched right up to the batsman and this time Smith goes for a drive through the covers. The throw came in nice and flat and the stumps were dislodged by the wicket-keeper, prompting an appeal and a call for the third-umpire. Smith makes it home easily, however.
good length ball, and Uthappa forces it to the backward square-leg for a single.
a swipe and for a moment it looked like it had connected but goes straight to the deep square-leg.
pitched right up to the bat and Smith tries to give himself room but cannot get it away.
full-pitched on the leg-side and it is chipped away by Smith to deep square-leg for a couple of runs.
another full-pitched ball from Harbhajan and Smith smacks it straight to long-on.
full-toss and the batsman should have probably sent it away into the stands., instead, he gets it down the long-on for a run.
swept hard by Smith but straight to the fielder at square-leg.
short from Harbhajan and Uthappa pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
pitched right up to Uthappa who fails to get a bat on it.
Pitched right up to the bat and Uthappa goes for that reverse sweep, does not get bat.
shimmies to the off-stump and wants to scoop it over fine-leg but the lack of pace makes it difficult for the batsman.
short and wide and that goes for a wide.
plays it away to the leg-side and went for a run. Any other bowler, that could have been an easy one but Pollard lunges to his right and makes it difficult for the batsman.
pitched right up to the batsman who drives through mid-wicket and goes to the other end.
continues to tease the batsmen with the lack of pace and Smith taps it to the leg-side for the third single of the over.
Uthappa keeps walking towards the off-stump and nudges it to the short fine-leg for a single.
nudges it to the leg-side and quickly goes for a run. Wanted to go for the second run but decide against it.
another short one and Smith goes for a pull again. But this time it goes straight to the deep square-leg for a single. Some momentum in that over.
defends it away on the off-side for a single. Good batting after those two successive fours.
pitched up outside the off-stump and Smith drills it to long-off for a single.
dabs it on the off-side and rushes off for a single.
this time it is pitched right up and down the leg-side. Uthapp moves slightly towards the off-stump and rolls the wrist to get it past the short fine-leg fielder.
short from Franklin and allowed Uthappa to go for the pull, he was itching to go after the bowling alright!
played away to the third-man for a single Uthappa's got many a singles in this innings, would be itching to have a go.
again the lack of pace makes it difficult for the batsman, who was going for a pull. He gets the bottom of the bat and only a single off the mid-hit.
again, a shimmy towards the off-stump and played away to the short fine-leg for a single
played away down the leg-side and despite Harbhajan Singh's best efforts at the short fine-leg, he gets a couple.
way down the leg-side and it is a wide.
darting in slowly to the batsman, who guides it to the third-man region for a single.
slowish one again and defended by Smith on the front-foot.
and again, turn! Uthappa has been there for some time and he still gets beaten while defending on the front-foot. This is excellent stuff.
pitched up to the bat and driven through the covers by Smith.
a bit of spin and Smith's beaten outside the off-stump.
Uthappa, who has been quiet for some time now, drives to long-off for a run.
this time it is pitched right up and Smith drives well through the covers for a run.
spin again and the batsman wanted to come down the pitch to smash him away.
short and pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a single.

gone this time! run-out! Harbhajan may have dropped the catch off the previous ball but this is super stuff from the Mumbai Indians. The batsman drove into the covers and went off for a single, Rohit Sharma was at the edge of the circle and he took an aim at the striker's end. It hits direct and Ferguson is gone!

Dropped! That was a difficult catch alright but given the standards Mumbai Indians have set this season, it should have been taken. Full-toss down the leg-side and flicked away to the square-leg fielder. Diving effort, put down.
gives himself room and cuts it away to the sweeper fence, it looked to be going for four for most part of its journey but a superb diving save from Rayadu saves a couple.
another slowish ball, and Uthappa continues to open the face of his bat. Single to the short third-man.
slower one, an off-spinner and Uthappa drives through mid-wicket for a couple.
cuts hard at it but can only edge it and it was in the air. Just falls short of the fielder, Levi, at short third-man.
tries to drive again but this time it is in the air and goes one bounce to the short cover.
inside out from Ferguson and that is an excellent shot on a wicket as slow as this. bounced just short of the fence.
sweeps hard and that should have probably gone to the fence, but Pollard's big boot prevents that
more turn! this time it is from outside the leg-side and beats the batsman again!
Stretches forward and pushes into the covers but no chance of a single
bounce and pace! All of a sudden, out of nowhere he bends his back and Uthappa was not equal to it. Beats the outside edge of the bat.
he tries to cut it away again but this time they have a wide slip in place and it is straight to him.
short and a bit wide and Uthappa cuts it away to the right of third-man. An easy two for the batsman.
slower one, pitched up and Uthappa checks his shot. Scrambled seam there.
short and pulled away by Ferguson. The man at deep square-leg fields and prevents the possibility of a second.
driven through the covers for a single. The field is now spread a little more.
huge turn again and there is an appeal for a stumping. The umpire calls for the third umpire and on replays it shows that his red shoe is back behind the crease when the bails came out.
beaten in the flight but does well to drive it to long-off
whoa! that was some sharp turn, away from the batsman and beat Uthappa all ends.
tries to drive again but does not get any bat on it.
pitched right up again and it is driven straight to the long-off for a run.
driven to the covers but gets no run.
pitched right up and Ferguson drives it well, off the middle of his bat. Straight to mid-off and he gets nothing for his stroke.

Bowled him! Munaf Patel has a wicket in his first over of this season! Parnell tried to go for an expansive drive and the ball was nowhere close to that length. It took a bit of an inside edge to go with some seam movement inside and the bails were dislodged.
Munaf pitches this one up further and Uthappa digs it out well to the off-side.. The goes for a quick single.
deliberately opens the face of the bat and gets a four through to the left of third-man. Delicate!
outside the off-stump, pitched right up and driven by Parnell for a single.
pitched right up to Uthappa who punches it into the ground and over Patel for a single. Mid-on needed to move to his left to field that one.
pulled away, not really hard but in the gap and it goes to the fence. Good end to the over which also saw a wicket fall.
tries to work it away to the leg-side but a leading edge gets him a single to get off the mark.
gone, gone! Ganguly is a goner, trying to go down the track after he had done that in Harbhajan's last over as well but he misses it completely and Dinesh Karthik does the rest.
charges down the pitch but Harbhajan saw that early enough to change his length. Hits the pad.
swept away and finally a four! This was a bit short and still swept away by Parnell, almost Hayden-style!
cut away off a short one from Harbhajan and it takes a misfield to get Ganguly a single.
another yorker length ball and it seemed to be going down the leg-side. Malinga appealed for a decision in his favour but that did not seem out.
that is cut away, or at least attempted to cut away and the edge almost goes to the lone slip. Just over him!
flashed away to the off-side and it was in air for a long time before going to third-man for a single.
bouncer and ducked into it by Parnell, it hits the helmet and goes all the way over the keeper for a four. Leg-byes...
another slower one which is driven into the covers. Fielded easily and again, no runs off the bat against Malinga.
pulls his length back a little and Parnell attempts a cut. More of a swish than a cut actually and he gets nothing on the bat.
another slower one fullish but wide outside the off-stump and the umpire flexes his arms.
Ganguly wanted to come out of his crease and send him over the in-field but Harbhajan saw that early and pitched it short.
bit of a leading edge towards the long-on region and Parnell also gets off the mark.
defended on the front foot to point.
comes into the batsman and does not turn this time. Beaten but the appeal was aborted.
on the leg-stump, it was a tad short and turning away from Ganguly, who plays it away to square-leg for a single.
short of length and Ganguly cuts it to the point region.
full-toss and Parnell should crashed that through the covers. Instead, he hits it straight to the fielder and that is the end of a maiden over.

Bowled him! Slower one and it looked like the four dot balls seemed to have worked on the batsman's mind. He went for a forceful shot over the leg-side but he missed it completely and Malinga's delivery sneaked through the defences!
another yorker, on the leg-stump and Pandey digs it out well. But then suddenly wanted to take a single and Malinga threw it back, missed the stumps but Pandey was home.
slower one so early! Pandey was almost committed to the stroke before having to defend towards the point region. Wanted the single but Ganguly was having nothing of it.
Pitched up, not quite a yorker and Pandey defends on the front-foot. A tad tentative which is perfectly understandable.
yorker length straight away and a bit of away swing from the leg-stump towards the middle. Defended by Pandey.
defended clumsily but that will do for Pune, they have won by 29 runs on a slow Wankhede pitch.
pitched up again and he drives to the covers for no run. Can Dinda get his fifth wicket?
gone, plumb in front of the wickets! Harbhajan went for an expansive slog over the mid-wicket region, but he misses and that one hits the back-foot.
yorker-length and Harbhajan smashes it back to long-on. Refuses the single again.
slower one and that is spanked away by Harbhajan Singh between long-on and mid-wicket. Too little, too late.
Full-toss and Harbhajan tries to smack it away but can only manage to get it to long-on. Refuses the single.
bouncer to finish off his spell! Ojha lets that one go to the wicket-keeper.
gone! Caught-behind! That was pitched up to the batsman and Malinga went for a drive, got only the outside-edge and he is easily taken by Uthappa.
yorker and edged away from the bottom of the bat to the fence.
this time he finally gets bat on to it but only a single to the extra-cover fielder.
fullish on the off-stump and that's very well-bowled. Harbhajan fails to connect.
swings hard and misses.
and another one in he blockhole to finish off his third over. Dug out by Harbhajan and he will keep strike with that single. He has conceded 13 from his three.
full, on the off-stump and Malinga swings. Gets the bottom of the bat and it trickles down to long-on for a run.
yorker-length and Harbhajan drills it to the long-on region for a single.

that is an excellent catch by Ferguson at mid-wicket as Franklin tries to pull the ball away. In the process, he does not hit the middle of the bat, which also flies out of his hands. He has probably not played a stroke in anger for a long time and it showed there...
slower one outside the off-stump. Harbhajan was shaping up for the yorker and he had to check his shot and drive it away to the deep cover region for only a run.
full-pitched and dug out well for a single. Oh but wait, there is an overthrow and Harbhajan dives hard into his crease to get back for two. Ganguly is furious.
shorter one and Harbhajan tries to go for a pull but mistimes the shot.
Harbhajan tries to drill it through the covers but it is straight to the fielder.
Franklin cuts away this time but only for a single.
full-toss and that is thwacked to the long-off fielder. Only a single.
shot! first ball four for Harbhajan! That was a quicker one again and Harbhajan smashed it down the ground, giving no fielder a chance.
down the leg-side and rather quick. Loud, loud appeal but the umpire reckons its not pitched in line.
Bowled him! Last ball of Rahul Sharma's spell, quicker one and that has gone through the defences of Pollard! It was one of those Anil Kumble-like fizzers that left most batsmen struggling to pick.
good bowling, pushes it quicker and Pollard has no choice but to defend here.
whips it away to the leg-side and that is an easily taken single. What is not easy is the required rate!
beaten! Short outside the off-stump and Franklin goes for a cut but misses.
short and that chould have been hit out of the park, instead it's smashed back to the bowler, who gets a hand on to it.
tapped away to the off-side and Franklin gets another single. He is interested only in rotating strike at the moment.
whoa! change of angle for Kartik and he pushes this one quicker but pitches it further on to the batsman. Beats Pollard all ends and he is lucky that the off-stump isn't pegged back.
Franklin drives the good length ball from Kartik to long-on.
short again from Kartik and Pollard is content with pushing it away to the square-leg for a run.
shortish from Kartik and Pollard almost wants to beat it away. Down to the right of long-on for a couple.
outside the off-stump but goes straight on with the arm, punched away to the leg-side for a single.
short ball and Pollard goes back deep into his crease and whips it to the leg-side. Gets a run, wanted a second but does not risk it.
goes on the back-foot, and plays it behind square to stroll off for a single.
shorter one and this time it is pulled away by Franklin for a run.
finally tries to go for a big shot but the ball is shorter and beats Franklin again.
and now he defends on the front foot!
turn for Rahul Sharma and Franklin defends that short ball on the back-foot.
punches him off the back-foot and that gives him a single to the point region.
straightish ball, hitting him on his pads and a bit of an appeal but it seemed like it was pitching outside the leg-stump
defended on the front foot by Franklin and it's gone straight to the fielder.
driven straight down the track and he is now off the mark. The required rate's gone up to almost 9 now.
Five wickets down now and Kieron Pollard comes in now. One way or the other this could get exciting now!
sneaks through and he is bowled! Yadav is bowled, quick ball, no turn and Samuels has sent Suryakumar Yadav back.
whipped it to the short fine-leg and runs off for a single.
cut away this time but Smith does a good job of fielding it at point.
dabbed away but for a single only.
cut away for a single to point.

what are they doing here? Outside the off-stump and played gently away to long-on. The batsmen wanted and went for a second and a really poor throw from the long-on beats everyone behind the stumps and it goes for six runs!
drives on the up and in the air but safely away from the short extra-cover fielder. A couple of runs for the batsman.
Outside the off-stump and Franklin fails to get the cut going.
some turn for Kartik again! Suryakumar was defending it on the back-foot and manages to get the bat down in time.

gone! Stumped! Kartik's got Karthik! It was short once again but this time it was because the batsman was coming down the pitch and he misses totally. Uthappa, behind the stumps has done a good job of it.
short again and hence no turn for Kartik. Franklin plays it away to deep square-leg.
a little short and Karthik manages to tap it away to the off-side for a run.
well-swept by Karthik, it was a tad short from the left-arm spinner and he got it well in the middle of the bat to the fine-leg.
goes down the track and drills it away but straight to short cover!
another slower one and Karthik gently dabs it away for a single to the off-side. Good over from Kumar.
slower one, a leg-spinner and it actually spun a little. Franklin adjusted well and tapped it to the leg-side for a single.
outside the off-stump on a length and Franklin tries to cut it away through the point. But straight to the fielder.
flicked away with some style! He will rue the fact that he's got only a single to fine-leg.
oooh! That was outside the off-stump and Karthik wanted to run it down the third-man but got no bat to it.
pitched up on the off-stump at a gentle speed and driven down the ground for a single to long-off.
comes forward and defends it
outside off, knocks it down to extra cover
outside off, jabs it back to mid-wicket, easy single there
pitched on the off, tries to cut it but misses it completely
outside off, Karthik jams it back to the bowler
tossed up outside off, Karthik plays with the spin straight to cover
wide outside leg stump,
leg stump line, Karthik plays it off his hips to deep square for a single
outside off, Franklin rocks back and slashes it straight to deep point, go through for a comfortable single
well short, Karthik stays in the crease and hammers it over the keeper for a boundary, takes a leading edge
on the leg stump, chops it down to point for no run, Parnell is keeping it tight here
slightly short, Karthik looks to hook it to deep backward square but cant get hold of it,
fuller ball outside the off stump. Karthik drives it to sweeper cover for a  single
on the middle stump now. Franklin pushes to the leg side
fuller ball outside the off stump. Franklin comes forward and drives it to the cover fielder
down the leg stump line. Franklin turns it to short fine-leg
pushes it to midwicket for a single
short ball outside off. Karthik has enough time to rock back and pulls it to deep midwicket for a boundary
fuller ball on the middle and leg. Franklin looks to flick it and gets a leading edge to mid-off
short ball and much needed width outside the off stump.Franklin rises as he plays the cut shot over the infield. A superb looking shot that
moves down the track and defensively pushes it to mid-on for a single
comes forward and drives it to cover for a single
outside the off stump and short in length. Franklin, without the backfoot moving, cuts it to point
now there's the first six of the innings. Karthik comes down the track and lofts it over long-on. Spoils the over a touch. Karthik is looking to get a move on, now
flighted outside the off stump. Karthik comes forward and defends it to the off side
outside the off stump. Karthik comes forward and pushes it to the off side
wide down the leg side
on the leg stump again.This time Franklin comes forward and plays it with more power. As a resul, he gets only a single
on the leg stump and flighted up a touch more than normal. Franklin comes forward and turns it to deep midwicket for a couple
outside off, flays it with brute power to deep point boundary, that was exquisitely timed
on the off, arms shoulders for no run, that was shaping away
slightly short, hooks it straight to square leg for a single
Good length delivery shaping away from Karthik, plays it on the up but misses it completely
tossed up, drives it straight to mid-on for an easy single,
turned it to mid wicket for a single, plays it off his hips
drives it to the cover fielder off the frontfoot
GONE!, what a way to get out! well outside off. Chases it and gets an outside edge
what a shot for nothing, outside off, slaps it straight to cover for no run, looks disappointed with that shot
outside off angling away from the left hander, knocks it away to wide of mid-off for an easy single
Good length outside off, stays in the crease and crunches it to mid off for no run
another wide sliding down the leg side, well outside leg stump
wooosh!, sliding down the leg side, that was a screamer, well wide
slightly outside off, cracks it off the meat of tha bat towards point but straight to Karthik at point, Mumbai are ina spot of bother here
on good length, spinning away from the batsman, jams it to cover
on the leg side, punches it to mid wicket with soft hands
on the middle, stays in the crease and drives to long off for a single
what a ball that was, bamboozled Levi, it was moving away from him, comes forward a bit and looks to punch it back to the bowler, stumped in a flash, brilliant stuff from Uthappa
on the middle and leg, Levi  punches it to mid on, no run watsoever
